summary: Icecast 2 is a streaming media server written in C that handles audio and video transmission. It is commonly used to broadcast Internet radio stations or host private jukeboxes for multiple listeners.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice if you want to set up an independent online radio broadcast or a centralised audio streaming service.
watchOut: The software has no recent tagged releases or recorded commit activity in the repository, which may indicate stagnant maintenance or a lack of active updates.
deployNotes: As a C application, it typically runs as a standalone daemon and usually requires a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination securely.
